deck: Nifty closed at 25,801 (▲ 1.12%) and Sensex at 83,920 (▲ 1.08%). Over the last five sessions Nifty is up 0.8%. Brent crude is near $90 a barrel and the rupee at 92.66 to the dollar.
story: Of the 80 large stocks this page tracks, 56 rose and 24 fell. INDUSINDBK led the gainers (+8.59%), while VEDL fell the most (-2.32%). Bank Nifty ended ▲ 2.49%.
Across markets: Brent crude near $90 a barrel (-6.0% on the week), the rupee at 92.66 per dollar (stronger on the week), gold near $3,524 an ounce.

In the headlines: “Closing Bell: D-St shrugs off weak global cues; Nifty at 25,800, Sensex gains 898 pts” (IndiaIPO). “Iran Just Got Handed the Bill for the Tanker War: More Than 133 Attacks on Oil Tankers and Damage That Could Last Decades” (National Security Journal).
One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is down 6.0% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 92.66 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
